DIAGNOSIS READY: Frontotemporal Dementia (Behavioral Variant)

The specific combination of new-onset disinhibited behavior (inappropriate comments, seeking intimacy), profound hyperphagia with specific cravings leading to significant weight gain, and personality changes (disinterest in family, unkempt appearance) over six months is highly characteristic of the behavioral variant of frontotemporal dementia.
